habitat: Riverine forest, broad-leaved woodland, forests, exotic plantations and suburbia. Behaviour is like the Cape White-eye.
summary: A common resident. Yellow-green above, with a yellow forecrown and entirely clear yellow underparts. The white eye-ring is unbroken by black lores. The call is like the Cape White-eye. The page uses Zosterops senegalensis. This list keeps Zosterops anderssoni. Avibase marks it rare, so the months are left unset. The Kemp name Yellow White-eye and the code RB were left unchanged.

calls.description: Calls like the Cape White-eye. No South African grade A recording was found under Zosterops anderssoni or Zosterops senegalensis. The grade A call is from Mutinondo in Zambia. The filename is XC660759-Southern White-eye (call) 20201206,Mutinondo,Muchinga,ZAMBIA.mp3.
